user.title: Gree Climate Setup
user.description: Choose how to discover your Gree device

cloud_add.title: Gree Account
cloud_add.description: Enter the details to connect to your Gree account

local_add.title: Local Discovery
local_add.description:
Devices will be automatically discovered by scanning the available networks.

If you have devices on a different subnet or VLAN, enter one or more networks and/or specific IP addresses to probe via unicast. Inter-VLAN routing and firewall rules must allow UDP port 7000 from Home Assistant to the target subnet.

device_picker.title: Discovered Devices
device_picker.description:
Found {devices_found} Gree device(s). Select the devices you want to configure.

Caution: If you are reconfiguring devices, unselected devices will be removed.

connection_options.title: Connection Options {device_idx} of {device_cnt}
connection_options.description:
Configure the connection options that will use for the device:

{device_name}

data_description.encryption_key: If left empty will be automatically discovered
data_description.scan_interval: Frequency of the device data polling (in seconds)
data_description.uid: The user ID number that owns the device. Can be 0 if not known

data.mac_controller_local: MAC of the local controller device (discovered: {discovered_mac_local})

data_description.max_online_attempts: The number of attempts to communicate with the device before it is marked as unavailable
data_description.timeout: The timeout for each of the connection attempts

data.mac_controller_cloud: MAC of the cloud controller device (discovered: {discovered_mac_cloud})

data_description.prefer_cloud: Devices prefer local connections. Check if you prefer this device to connect through the cloud

device_options.title: Device Features {device_idx} of {device_cnt}
device_options.description:
The Gree API doesn't have a reliable method of getting the supported features of a device. Please use the options bellow to the best of your knowledge about your device:

 {device_name}

data_description.external_temperature_sensor: If set will replace the built-in HVAC temperature sensor for the Climate entity data
data_description.external_humidity_sensor: If set will replace the built-in HVAC humidity sensor for the Climate entity data
data_description.restore_states: If checked, when the integration is started the device will be overridden by previous states of the integration instead of using the current device state.
data_description.target_temp_step: Sets the increment step for adjusting the target temperature. Fahrenheit degrees are clamped to the nearest integer.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Devices
reconfigure.description: You are reconfiguring a entry with a cloud account. Do you want to look for local devices that match your cloud devices?
